summary: Ranking mini-game revamp verified end-to-end (frontend only, per request). Test episode 6a792784202395ef43859ca1 ('Test Ranking') data structure is correct: mini_game.type='ranking', data={items:[3 items]}, instructions holds the merged consigne, and NO 'question' field is present. Frontend behavior verified on mobile viewport (390x844): (1) Pre-Démarrer screen shows title + instructions ('Parmi ces 3 situations, lesquelles t énervent le plus ?') + list icon + Démarrer button, and 'Nous avons terminé' is NOT visible. (2) After tapping Démarrer, items are rendered as a static list with a small orange bullet (ellipse icon) before each item text: NO numbered badges (1,2,3), NO up/down arrows, no chevron-up/chevron-down in DOM, no standalone '1'/'2'/'3' text nodes. (3) Clicking an item does NOT reorder the list — order remains stable (Devoir faire ses devoirs < Perdre au foot < Se faire embêter). (4) 'Nous avons terminé' bottom button appears after reveal and advances the session to the closing 'mot pour résumer' step. (5) Non-regression: Letters game (episode 'Mes qualités') still uses the same Démarrer flow and reveals 4 letters + terminate button. (6) Admin panel at /api/admin-panel → Épisodes tab → ranking type: only 'Situations à afficher' textarea (#episode-ranking-items) is shown; the legacy 'Question de classement' label and #episode-ranking-question input are BOTH removed.

rankingItemSimple style (session/[episodeId].tsx:1380) replaces the old numbered rankingItem with a subtle-border, non-interactive row containing an ellipse bullet — matches the spec.
admin.html (392-404, 517-528) removed the 'Question de classement' input; POST payload for ranking type now sends only { data: { items } }, matching the new backend expectation.

Instruction rendering is de-duplicated: GameStepContent skips the shared gameInstructions block for letters/ranking (line 455), delegating to the game's own pre-reveal screen — avoids showing instructions twice.
